title: Inception
overview: A thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO, descending through layered dreams where time and reality blur.

title: The Godfather
overview: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son, exploring family loyalty, power, and moral corruption.

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
overview: A heartbroken man undergoes a procedure to erase memories of his ex-girlfriend, only to discover deep within his mind that he still loves her, a meditation on memory and loss.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
overview: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search of her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners and a drifter.

title: Parasite
overview: A poor family schemes to become employed by a wealthy family by infiltrating their household, exposing class divides that spiral into dark, unpredictable consequences.

title: Her
overview: A lonely writer develops an unlikely relationship with an operating system designed to meet his every need, exploring loneliness, love, and what it means to connect.

title: No Country for Old Men
overview: A hunter stumbles upon a drug deal gone wrong and a briefcase of money in the desert, and finds himself pursued by a relentless, philosophical killer.

title: La La Land
overview: An aspiring actress and a dedicated jazz musician fall in love in Los Angeles while pursuing their dreams, torn between ambition and romance.

title: The Prestige
overview: Two rival magicians engage in a bitter and escalating battle of one-upmanship, obsessed with creating the ultimate stage illusion at great personal cost.

title: Whiplash
overview: A young jazz drummer enrolls at a cutthroat music conservatory where his abusive instructor pushes him toward greatness through psychological torment.

title: Arrival
overview: A linguist is recruited by the military to communicate with alien visitors, uncovering a message about time, language, and loss that reshapes her understanding of her own life.

title: The Departed
overview: An undercover cop and a mole in the police attempt to identify each other while infiltrating an Irish gang in Boston, told through escalating tension and betrayal.

title: Lost in Translation
overview: Two strangers, a jaded actor and a neglected young woman, form an unlikely bond during a bout of insomnia in Tokyo, quietly exploring isolation and connection.

title: Gone Girl
overview: A man becomes the prime suspect in his wife's disappearance as the media and public turn against him, unraveling a dark story about marriage and deception.

title: Interstellar
overview: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival, confronting love, time, and sacrifice across galaxies.
